import.title: Import CSV
import.subtitle: Import transactions from a file. Useful for trying the app without a bank, or backfilling older data.
import.formatBody: The file must have these five columns in its header. Column order is flexible and names are case-insensitive.
import.hintAmount: Amounts are signed — negative for outflows, positive for income. Use a period as decimal separator.
import.hintCurrency: Currency is a 3-letter code (EUR, USD, …). Leave blank to default to EUR.
import.hintDedupe: Re-importing the same file is safe — duplicate rows are detected by content hash.
import.hintAi: Don't worry if your bank's export looks different — the AI can detect other column names, semicolon delimiters, EU date and number formats, and separate debit/credit columns.
import.pasteLabel: Paste CSV here, or pick a file below
import.errorsTitle: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
import.emptyError: The file is empty or no CSV was pasted.
import.fileTooLargeError: File is too large. Max 2 MB.
import.modeAutoHint: Try the standard format first; ask the AI if it doesn't match.
import.modeAiHint: Skip the strict parser and let the AI detect any layout.
import.modeStrictHint: No AI — file must match the canonical header exactly.
import.aiUsedBody: The AI inferred your file's layout and converted it on the fly.
import.aiUnavailableError: Couldn't reach the AI to detect the format. Check your local model is running, or pick "Strict only" mode if your file already matches the canonical header.
import.allRowsFailedError: Every row failed to parse. The detected format may be wrong — try a different file or contact support.
import.cloudConsentRequiredError: AI format detection would call your configured cloud provider. Open Settings → AI Coach and approve cloud-LLM use first, or pick "Strict only" mode.
import.sampleBody: Don't have a CSV handy? Import 30 realistic transactions across 3 months so you can explore the dashboard, subscriptions, and coach immediately.

advisor.title: AI Coach
advisor.empty: Ask me about your spending, budgets, or how to save this month. I only see aggregated numbers, never individual transactions.
advisor.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.
advisor.consentTitle: Send summary to a cloud AI?
advisor.consentBody:
To answer I'll use {provider}. Only aggregated summaries are sent (category totals, budgets) — with anonymized merchant names and no account numbers or individual transactions.

You can revoke this permission anytime in Settings.
advisor.errorRequest: Could not reach the AI. Try again.
